name: B10-0497/2026 (PPE) – Ukrainian children forcibly deported to Russia or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Russia for deporting Ukrainian children to Russia, forcing them into Russian families, schools and military-style training, and for doing the same in occupied Ukrainian areas. It calls on Russia to return all these children safely and without conditions, to give full information about them, and to let aid groups reach them. It also asks the European Union to keep funding their recovery, to consider more sanctions, and to back the International Criminal Court. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet in law; the Parliament demands Russia return all deported children and share full information about them.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian children taken to Russia or Belarus, or living under Russian occupation, and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the European Union's Council and Commission, Ukraine, Russia and Belarus; the Parliament urges more sanctions and continued funding for children's recovery.
